However, none of the cited passages provide evidence that this uniform distribution leads to homogeneous tribo-oxide nucleation, that the oxide layer reduces crack initiation and wear, or that disrupting the balance increases wear. E2 only reports hardness increase and oxide formation after thermal treatment, not under sliding wear. premises: Equiatomic composition ensures uniform elemental distribution and inhibits phase separation.
Uniform elemental distribution promotes homogeneous nucleation of a protective tribo-oxide layer.

Disrupting the equiatomic balance (e.g., reducing Cu) leads to uneven oxide formation and higher wear.
